CONCLUSIONS: The pre-flight REFUSES both grids. Grid 1: strict ceiling 1 of 12, best reachable p = 1.0. Grid 2: strict ceiling 2 of 5 comparable cells (3 of 8 were MISSING, all on the same arm -- the drop asymmetry that grid flagged itself), best reachable p = 0.5. Neither could have reached p<0.05 under any outcome.

RETRACTED (2026-07-30): the claim that grid 1's ATTRIBUTABLE perturbation is ZERO. It rested on a cross-experiment pairing that is not an A/A -- the held-out arm predates the retention treatment by >=6 agentic commits. Grid 1's one perturbed cell is UNATTRIBUTABLE, which is a weaker and honest statement. The REFUSE verdict is unaffected.

RETRACTED (2026-07-30): the '2 of 5 cells differ under IDENTICAL code' rate, for the same reason. Replaced by a real same-commit A/A: 1 of 2 pairs diverges EVEN WITH the sampler seed set (ft09, first divergence at action 26, and the two runs disagreed on whether a plan was found at all: 1 vs 0). n=2 supports 'this happens', not a rate, and no rate is claimed. The operational conclusion is unchanged and now rests on sound evidence: seeding the sampler is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT, so a noise floor must be MEASURED per grid rather than assumed.

The lesson generalises past this incident: a noise floor assembled out of convenient nearby data is not a noise floor. 'Same treatment flag' is not 'same code', and the check that catches it is structural -- compare the fields the two cells actually record, not an argument about how they were configured.

GRID_1_cross_experiment_pairing_RETRACTE.RETRACTION: This section previously reported a 'free A/A noise floor' built by pairing the retention grid's `ret1` cells against the held-out grid's `31b` cells, on the grounds that both were retention-ON at seed 1 on the same GGUF for the same anonymised game. THAT PAIRING IS NOT AN A/A AND THE CLAIMS DRAWN FROM IT ARE WITHDRAWN. The held-out cells ran BEFORE commit 11cd3c3a9 introduced engine retention at all -- they carry none of the retention_requested / retention_enabled_effective / retention_support fields that every post-11cd3c3a9 cell carries -- so at least six agentic commits separate the two sets and the comparison is an A/B of the very treatment under test.
GRID_1_cross_experiment_pairing_RETRACTE.SMALL_SAMPLE_CAVEAT_ALSO_RETRACTED_the_r: The A/A rate is 2 of 5 -- n=5. A 95% Wilson interval on that proportion is roughly [0.12, 0.77], so '40%' is a POINT ESTIMATE with very wide uncertainty and must not be quoted as a calibrated figure. What the five cells DO establish beyond the rate is the QUALITATIVE fact that matters: at least one cell (vc33) -- specifically the retention grid's only perturbed cell -- differs under identical code, so that grid's attributable perturbation is zero. That conclusion needs one counterexample, not a calibrated rate. The rate itself is reported only to convey that the floor is NOT negligible, and it is superseded by the direct root-cause finding: the generator sent no seed at all, which was then verified live (4 identical requests at T=0.4 gave 3 distinct completions unseeded, 1 seeded).
GRID_1_cross_experiment_pairing_RETRACTE.aa_pair_definition_RETRACTED_AS_INVALID: ret1 (retention ON, retention-grid session) vs 31b (held-out-grid session). ASSERTED to differ only in session and wall_s cap. In fact differs in CODE: the held-out arm predates the retention treatment entirely.

VC33_CROSS_EXPERIMENT_REPLICATE_SET.finding_NARROWED_2026_07_30:
SURVIVING OBSERVATION: all four runs share a byte-identical prefix through action 16 and, where they diverge, they diverge at the SAME index 17 -- consistent with a single branch point in the agent's decision sequence rather than drift. That is a lead for LOCATING the nondeterminism.

WITHDRAWN INFERENCE: this previously concluded 'a treatment effect cannot produce that pattern, so index 17 is a harness nondeterminism point'. The four runs are not matched -- they differ in commit, and two differ in generator_output_reached_policy and in whether the run completed -- so the partition crossing treatment lines has explanations other than harness noise, and the inference does not follow.
VC33_CROSS_EXPERIMENT_REPLICATE_SET.why: vc33 was the ONLY perturbed cell in the retention grid and the cell that banked the most levels in the whole corpus, so whether its divergence was treatment or noise decides how that grid should be read.

field_principles.CONCLUSIONS: Stated as claims a reader can check against the per-cell records above, rather than as a summary they must trust.
field_principles.GRID_1_with_the_free_aa_noise_floor.aa_p: Perturbations between two runs of the SAME code. Any A/B perturbation at or below this rate is indistinguishable from noise, so this number bounds what any A/B on this harness can claim.
field_principles.VC33_CROSS_EXPERIMENT_REPLICATE_SET.pair: A treatment effect must partition runs along treatment lines. A partition that crosses treatments falsifies the treatment explanation without needing any new run -- which is why the matrix is recorded rather than a single verdict.
